Terrain binding never moves the building datum
Historic railways and travelling machinery are not passed off as current surviving geometry
Plan and section share the same four hall and monitor definitions
Every render resource has one explicit model owner
Repeated instantiation does not share disposable resources

limitations: The 120 × 80 m envelope and hall arrangement are documentary. Fine structural dimensions, repetition counts and material wear are proportional interpretations, not a measured survey.
The count of three internal division rows follows the visible four-hall topology. Inventories that say four rows may count a different support boundary.
Regional terrain, neighbouring buildings, responsive framing and the final renderer are reviewed separately.
